notes: Gauntling Arc Core, 4x4: four mismatched plates (pale steel, rust, dark steel, patched) welded round a copper-wound ring with a steel ball in the middle; four electrode posts in the corners and cyan arcs that jump from the ball to a different post each frame (the 4-frame loop). Off: dark ball, windings dull. Damaged: a post sheared off and arcing to the casing, a plate lifting, the ball stuttering. Disabled: the ball cracked and dead, windings burnt, plates split.
